biggest_catch: Fastest pay in the lane (7-10 business days) but most shops REQUIRE an upfront purchase — you float the money until reimbursement clears.
catches: Nearly every shop requires an upfront purchase or paid service — must be prepared to spend your own money.
Job availability is highly location-dependent; small towns may see ~1 shop/month.
Quality-control validators can bounce reports; 24-hour window to answer questions.
Some assignments (mortgage assessments) leave a credit check on your file.
